items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was with Tony Almarico for a while. When I was down here during the war I heard him. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: He played with Sharky quite a while. He played with a lot of the bands. I mean he played with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings. The Halfway House.
He was with Tony Almarico for a while. When I was down here during the war I heard him.
